name: Kannami (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kannami town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kannami, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 18 June 1969.

features.role: Kannami town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes
